name: motion-jelly-squash
title: Jelly Squash
description: Bấm nút, nút rung bẹp dọc giãn ngang như thạch rồi tắt dần, diện tích giữ nguyên, chân nút đứng yên.

moworks.author: takayu

options.fadeStart: s after the press the wobble fades from (1.6)
options.cursor: an optional cursor that makes the clicks
options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-button-jelly-squash, written here): On press (0.55 s): d(t) = 0.2 × e^(−3.4 t) × cos(17 t), ramped in over 50 ms (power1.out); scaleX = 1 + d, scaleY = 1 / (1 + d) (area kept), origin bottom centre; the wobble lasts about 1.3 s and is faded to 0 between 1.6-2.0 s after the press. Equivalent spring k290 d6.8 (site value). Button 140x46 r16. Params: at · amp (0.2) · freq (17 rad/s) · decay (3.4) · origin (đáy giữa). d(t) = amp × e^(−decay t) × cos(freq t); scaleX = 1 + d, scaleY = 1 / (1 + d), so the area is kept; about a spring k 290, damping 6.8.
moworks.titleVi: Nút rung như thạch, giữ thể tích
